subject: science
title: Alive, once alive or never alive
titleId: Hidup, pernah hidup, atau tidak pernah hidup
canDo: I can sort things into alive, once alive and never alive, and say what living things do.

subject: science
title: What plants need to grow
canDo: I can say what plants need to grow well and how they make their own food.

subject: science
title: Life cycles
canDo: I can put the stages in the life cycle of an animal or a plant in order.

subject: science
title: Staying healthy
canDo: I can explain how food, water, exercise, sleep and keeping clean help me stay healthy.

subject: science
title: Habitats
canDo: I can match living things to their habitats and say how they are suited to live there.

subject: science
title: Choosing materials
canDo: I can say if a material is natural or made by people and choose the best material for a job.

subject: science
title: Changing materials
canDo: I can describe how materials change when I squash, bend, twist, stretch, heat or cool them.

subject: science
title: Forces and movement
canDo: I can explain how pushes and pulls make things start, stop, speed up, slow down or turn.

subject: science
title: Light and dark
canDo: I can name light sources and explain why we cannot see in the dark.

subject: science
title: Using electricity safely
canDo: I can name things that use electricity and say how to stay safe near it.

subject: science
title: Rocks and soil
canDo: I can describe rocks and soil and say how people use them.

subject: science
title: Weather and seasons
canDo: I can describe and measure the weather and explain the rainy and dry seasons.

subject: science
title: Day and night
canDo: I can explain that day and night happen because the Earth spins.

subject: science
title: Testing, measuring and recording
canDo: I can predict, plan a fair test, measure and record my results in a table or chart.
